# 50 Salads

Synchronized food-preparation video and accelerometer data reused for future procedure prediction.

## Example input and output

This is a source-grounded illustration of the task shape, not a copied or verified dataset row.

**Input:** An observed prefix of salad preparation with aligned sensor readings.

**Output / label:** The upcoming annotated recipe action in the cited anticipation setup.

[Open the author-provided sample or demo](https://discovery.dundee.ac.uk/files/10245400/50salads.pdf)

**Example evidence:** [official](https://discovery.dundee.ac.uk/files/10245400/50salads.pdf), [anticipation_paper](https://openaccess.thecvf.com/content/CVPR2026/papers/Shao_Prototypical_Action_Reasoning_Facilitated_by_Vision-Language_Alignment_for_Egocentric_Action_CVPR_2026_paper.pdf)

## Intention in this dataset

Predict an upcoming recipe action from an observed prefix in PAR-VLA; original activity intervals describe behavior rather than intention.

**Relevance:** `implicit` · **Origin:** `real` · **Year:** 2013

**Domains:** daily_activities, human_object_interaction  
**Intention types:** action, task_goal  
**Tasks:** action_anticipation  
**Modalities:** rgb, depth, imu  
**Formats:** video, time_series, structured_annotation
